content: Jisas nangange ŋai lenge miyeꞌ 5.000
Miꞌe pe, Jisas nerŋe nal umbur pinip umun Galili. Naŋ umburꞌe kin pe, pinip umun Taiberias.
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge wula wula, si yetekeꞌe mirakel ŋaiye kin ŋende miꞌe wahriꞌ epwa pe, tinge jande kin yal.
Jisas ŋotop lenge jetalah kin yal yanah hwate pe, tinge lalme yarp ilyeh.
Dindiꞌ ŋup uku pe, ŋup tikin Pasova si nat sehei.

Jisas ŋahraꞌe ŋondoh anah bep nalꞌe nalꞌe pe, kin ŋetekeꞌe mitiŋ wondoh embere yatme kin. Taꞌe luku pe, kin ŋisilihme Filip na, “Yukoh windau sai ya ŋaiye ya mambaꞌe kakah muta mangang lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge leꞌe ka yono?”
Jisas ŋanange wusyep eꞌe ŋaiye kin da ondolꞌme Filip. Kut kin si sisyeme ŋaimune ŋaiye kin da ende.
Filip nungwisme wusyep kin na, “Ŋaiye ya miche wuhyau embere sekete mambaꞌe kakah wula pe, lenge mitiŋ ilyeh ilyeh se ka yambaꞌe kakah sikirp yono.”
O jetalah tikin Jisas ende, naŋ kin Andru pe, kin toꞌ tikin Saimon Pita ŋanange na,
“Lahyambe ende ŋaiye gan eꞌe pe, kin nenge kakah bali syepumbur topoꞌe ŋuyoꞌ hoi. Kom ŋai uku yukur ka se dindiꞌ me tinge lalme leꞌe.”
Jisas ŋana lenge na, “Yini lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ka juh yurp.” Taꞌe luku pe, lenge mitiŋ wondoh embere jah yarp peperiyeh ŋaiye gere sai. O wutuꞌ lenge miyeꞌ ilyehme pe, tatame 5,000.

Jisas nambaꞌe kakah ŋanange wusyep ŋirisukwarme Got miꞌe pe, kin ŋiyarꞌe nangange lenge mitiŋ lalme ŋaiye yarp uku. Kin ŋende ŋahilyeh nalme ŋuyoꞌ topoꞌe. Tinge lalme yono yal tatame ŋaiye tinge tapam.
Ŋupe ŋaiye tinge si tapam miꞌe pe, kin ŋana lenge jetalah kin na, “Jarase ŋai si sinde ŋaiye dur gah ŋanar pe, yukur ya se mende yupu yupur ŋai syeꞌ.”
Taꞌe luku pe, tinge jarase kakah si sinde ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ si yono kakah bali syepumbur no, dur gah pe, tinge yohor jah sorh syepumbur umbur hoi nal ŋihip.
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yetekeꞌe wah bongol ŋaiye Jisas ŋende pe, tinge yanange na, “Bwore mise! Leꞌe kin profet ŋaiye Got ŋanange nange ka ember ot kekep.”
Jisas si sisyeme ŋaiye tinge yala yende bongol yurpe kin yututusme ŋaiye ka orp kiŋ. Taꞌe luku pe, kin nasme moi uku pe, kin ilyeh nal hwate.
Jisas nange ŋanah pinip umun hlaꞌ
Dir nala yungwiris ŋup pe, lenge jetalah tikin Jisas ya jah pinip umun.
Tinge yal yoto loumbil pinip pe, tinge yerŋe yala yil Kaperneam. Kin nala ŋup, kom Jisas yukur nate gereme tinge.
Yohe embere tahar bongol nusupurꞌe pinip embere luku tahar kotou.

Lenge jetalah yenenem loumbil pinip yal tatame kilomita syepumbur lakai syepumbur ilyeh. Ŋupe ŋaiye tinge yetekeꞌe Jisas nange ŋanah pinip hlaꞌ nat sehei me loumbil pinip tinge pe, tinge hiꞌjarnge pupwa supule.
Jisas ŋana lenge na, “Yukur pa hiꞌjirnge! Ŋam ilyeh liꞌ ihei.”
Taꞌe luku pe, tinge hriphrip ŋaiye ka yambaꞌe kin yenge yil yoto loumbil pinip. Topoꞌe nilyehe sai loumbil pinip nal gere luh moi ŋaiye tinge yala yil.
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yahaiꞌe Jisas

Nyermbe pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ilyeh uku teter yarp yal pinip umun umbur uku. Tinge sisyeme nange Jisas yukur nal loumbil pinip topoꞌe lenge jetalah kin. Tinge yasme kin, kut tinge ilyehme yal.
Kom lenge loumbil pinip syeꞌ titinge Taiberias si yat sehei me luh uku ŋaiye Lahmborenge somohon ŋanange wusyep ŋirisukwarme Got me kakah no, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yono.
Ŋupe ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yetekeꞌe nange Jisas topoꞌe lenge jetalah kin yukur yarp pe, tinge plai yanah loumbil pinip uku pe, tinge yal Kaperneam yahaiꞌe Jisas.
Jisas kin kakah tikin moihlaꞌ
Ŋupe ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yetekeꞌe Jisas pe, tinge yiname na, “Jetmam, tumboiyaꞌ nin nat eꞌe?”

Jisas nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Ŋam mana yip bwore mise. Yip yono kakah ŋaiye ŋam yal yip depe yip tapam pe, luku tehei ŋaiye yip yahaiꞌe ŋam. Kom yip jinjame tehei tikin wutuꞌ supule ŋaiye yip yetekeꞌe pe, ŋoihmbwaip yip yukur teŋeime ŋam.

Yip yukur pa yende wah ŋaiye yambaꞌe ŋai ŋaiye ka pupwa! Napakai! Yip pa yende wah ŋaiye yambaꞌe ŋai tikin laip bwore ŋaiye sai nye nyermbe. Leꞌe ŋai ŋaiye Talah tikin Miyeꞌ ka yul yip. Detale, Got Yai si naŋaꞌe wutuꞌ me kin ŋaiye ka ende tuꞌe luku.”
Taꞌe luku pe, tinge yisilihme Jisas na, “Ya mende ŋaimune ŋaiye ki tatame ka gunde ŋasande tikin Got?”
Jisas nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Ŋaimune ŋaiye Got ŋasande yip pa yende pe, ŋoihmbwaip yip ka teŋeime miyeꞌ ŋaiye Got nember kin nat.”
Tinge yungwisme wusyep na, “Mirakel mune ŋaiye na ende ti, ya metekeꞌe no, ŋoihmbwaip poi ka teŋeime nin? Na ende wutuꞌ mune?
Lenge mwan kaꞌ poi yono mana yarp moi gungurar. Ki gande wusyep ŋaiye sai Tup tikin Got ŋanange, ‘Kin nangang lenge kakah tikin moihlaꞌ ŋaiye ka yono.’”
Jisas ŋanange na, “Ŋam mana yip bwore mise. Moses yukur yal yip kakah tikin moihlaꞌ, pakai. Yai ŋam, kin da yul yip kakah mise tikin moihlaꞌ.
Kakah ŋaiye Got da yul yip pe, kin nase moihlaꞌ gah. Pe ka angange laip bwore el lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme guh kekep.”
Tinge yisilihme Jisas na, “Lahmborenge, pul poi kakah eꞌe nye nyermbe!”
Jisas ŋana lenge na, “Ŋam kakah ŋaiye maŋaꞌe laip. Lahmende ŋaiye ka otme ŋam pe, yukur ka usyunde nimbot. Topoꞌe lahmende ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip kin ka teŋeime ŋam pe, yukur ka usyunde wonge salah.
Tukwini yip si yetekeꞌe ŋam, kom ŋoihmbwaip yip yukur teŋeime ŋam.
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ŋaiye Yai ŋam pwale pe, tinge ka yutme ŋam. Topoꞌe ŋam yukur ma gwenyenme lahmende ŋaiye si yatme ŋam.
Ŋam mase moihlaꞌ gwah ŋaiye ma mende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe gunde ŋasande tikin Yai ŋaiye nember ŋam mat. Ŋam yukur ma mende gunde ŋasande ŋam, pakai.
Yai ŋaiye nember ŋam mat pe, kin ŋasande tikin ŋaiye yukur ma se musme lahmende ŋaiye kin si pwale ŋam. O ŋaiye ŋup yuwo pe, ma mahraꞌe lenge lalme ka yambaꞌe laip bwore nye nyermbe.

Yai ŋam ki ŋasande taꞌe leꞌe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ŋaiye yetekeꞌe Talah no, ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime kin pe, ka yambaꞌe laip bwore ŋaiye sai nye nyermbe. Topoꞌe ŋaiye ŋup yuwo pe, ma plihe mahraꞌe tinge.”
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Juta tuhwar yanange wusyep sekete ŋaiye tinge yisande Jisas ŋanange na, “Ŋam kakah ŋaiye nase moihlaꞌ gah.”
Tinge yanange na, “Miyeꞌ eꞌe pe, kin Jisas, talah tikin Josep lakai? Poi sisyeme lenge yai mam kin. Detaꞌe lai ti kin ŋanange nange kin nase moihlaꞌ gah?”
Jisas nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Yip yukur pa yininge wusyep sekete yile yut yip tip.

Miyeꞌ lakai tuwei ende yukur tatame ka se yutme ŋam junde ŋasande tinge, pakai. Yai ka ahraꞌe ŋoihmbwaip ti, lakai kin ŋaiye ka enge tinge yutme ŋam. O ŋaiye ŋup yuwo pe, ma mahraꞌe kin, lakai ti ŋaiye ka yambaꞌe laip bwore.
Lenge profet yainge wusyep taꞌe leꞌe, ‘Got ka alaŋatme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ka yambaꞌe sande tekeꞌe.’ Lahmende miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye yisande wusyep Yai no, yambaꞌe sisyeme pe, ka yutme ŋam.
Miyeꞌ ende yukur ŋetekeꞌe Yai. Miyeꞌ ilyeh uku ŋaiye si narp topoꞌe Got no, kin nat pe, kin ilyeh si ŋetekeꞌe Yai.
Ŋam mana yip bwore mise. Miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime ŋam pe, ka yambaꞌe laip bwore ŋaiye sai nye nyermbe.
Ŋam kakah ŋaiye maŋaꞌe laip bwore.
Lenge mwan kaꞌ yip yono mana yarp moi gungurar, kom tinge yule.
Kom kakah ŋaiye nase moihlaꞌ gah pe, kin ŋoinde tikin ŋaiye lahmende ka yono pe, yukur ka yule.

Ŋam kakah laip bwore ŋaiye mase moihlaꞌ gwah. Lahmende ŋaiye ka ono kakah eꞌe pe, ka orp bwore nye nyermbe. Kakah ŋaiye ma maŋaꞌe pe, wahriꞌ ŋam. Ŋam mangange malme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme tikin kekep ŋaiye ka yambaꞌe laip bwore.”
Lenge Juta yisande wusyep uku pe, tinge tuhwar teketenge wusyep yale yat tititinge. Tinge yisilih na, “Detaꞌe lai ti miyeꞌ eꞌe ka pul poi wahriꞌ kin ya mono?”
Jisas ŋana lenge na, “Ŋam mana yip bwore mise. Ŋaiye yip yukur yono wahriꞌ tikin Talah tikin Miyeꞌ, topoꞌe yonoꞌe wim kin pe, laip bwore yukur sai nato yip.
Lahmende ŋaiye ka ono wahriꞌ ŋam, topoꞌe onoꞌe wim ŋam pe, ka ambaꞌe laip bwore ŋaiye sai nye nyermbe. Topoꞌe ŋup yuwo pe, ma mahraꞌe kin ka orp laip.
Taꞌe luku pe, wahriꞌ ŋam ki ŋai bwore mise, topoꞌe wim ŋam ki pinip bwore mise.
Lahmende ŋaiye ka ono wahriꞌ ŋam, topoꞌe onoꞌe wim ŋam pe, kin narp ŋoto ŋam topoꞌe ŋam marp moto kin.
Yai ŋaiye narp laip nye nyermbe nember ŋam mat. Topoꞌe kin tehei ti ŋam marp nye nyermbe. Taꞌe luku pe, yaŋah ilyeh ŋaiye miyeꞌ ka ono ŋam pe, ma mende kin ŋaiye ka orp laip.

Kakah ŋilyeh eꞌe si nase moihlaꞌ nate gah. Kin yukur ŋahilyeh taꞌe kakah ŋaiye somohon lenge mwan kaꞌ yip yono, kom ŋup syeꞌ nal miꞌe pe, tinge yule. Lahmende ŋaiye ka ono kakah eꞌe pe, ka orp laip nye nyermbe.”
Jisas ŋanange wusyep uku narp nato yukoh jahilyeh ŋaiye sai nato moi embere Kaperneam.
Wusyep tikin laip bwore ŋaiye sai nye nyermbe
Lenge jetalah Jisas wula wula yisande wusyep ŋaiye kin ŋanange pe, tinge yanange na, “Wusyep eꞌe ki nihe sekete. Lahmende tatame ka isyunde wusyep iki?”
Kom nato ŋoihmbwaip Jisas pe, kin sisyeme ŋaiye lenge jetalah kin yanange wusyep sekete me wusyep uku ŋaiye kin ŋanange. Pe kin ŋana lenge na, “Wusyep uku ŋende yumbune ŋoiheryembe mise yip lakai?
O ŋaiye mindemboi pa yetekeꞌe Talah tikin Miyeꞌ ka el unuh moihlaꞌ ŋaiye somohon kin narp yer pe, luku ka tuꞌe la?

Yipihinge tikin Got ki nangange laip bwore nal lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ŋaiye tinge yarp. O ŋaiye bongol lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ilyehme pe, yukur ka ende lenge ka yurp. Wusyep ŋaiye ŋam mana yip pe, ki yal yip laip bwore ŋaiye ka si nye nyermbe.
Kom yip syeꞌ iki, ŋoihmbwaip yip yukur teŋeime ŋam.” Jisas si sisyeme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge yukur teŋeime kin. Topoꞌe miyeꞌ ŋaiye ka ember kin el syep lenge wachaih.
Taꞌe luku pe, kin ŋanange na, “Leꞌe tehei kin ŋaiye ŋam mana yip na, yukur lahende tatame ka otme ŋam. Kom ŋaiye Yai ka aŋaꞌe bongol elme kin pe, kin tatame ka otme ŋam.”
Jisas ŋanange wusyep uku pe, lenge jetalah Jisas wula wula plihe bunjenge yisarꞌe yal. Topoꞌe tinge yukur tatame ka plihe yil yotop kin.
Taꞌe luku pe, kin ŋisilih lenge jetalah 12 kin na, “Taꞌe yip topoꞌe yala yusme ŋam no, pa yil lakai?”
Saimon Pita nungwisme wusyep kin na, “Lahmborenge, poi ya mil me lahmende? Wusyep nin, kin ŋenyel yaŋah nal laip bwore ŋaiye sai nye nyermbe.
Pe tukwini ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime nin. Topoꞌe poi sisyeme nange nin miyeꞌ bwore bwarme holi ŋilyeh uku ŋaiye Got nember nat.”
Jisas nungwisme wusyep na, “Ŋam si malaŋatme yip jetalah 12 iki, kom ŋoinde yip iki pe, kin Satan.”
Wusyep uku kin ŋanange nalme Judas, talah tikin Saimon Iskariot. Judas kin jetalah 12 ende, kom mindemboi ka ember Jisas el syep lenge wachaih.
